test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: To which of the following persons did Mamata Banerjee lose the Nandigram seat at the Assembly Polls held in March-April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suvendu Adhikari.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Mamata Banerjee lose the Nandigram seat at the Assembly Polls held in March-April 2021 to Suvendu Adhikari.**

 
• Mamata Banerjee has become the only woman Chief Minister to win three consecutive terms in India that too each time with a bigger margin.
 
• Mamata Banerjee was sworn in as West Bengal's Chief Minister for the third consecutive time on May 5, 2021.
 
• This comes after her party, All India Trinamool Congress secured a landslide win in the state with 213 seats out of the total 292 Assembly constituencies that went to polls. 
 
• Mamata Banerjee lost her battle in the Nandigram constituency despite winning a clear majority in the whole of West Bengal.
